priorityList: Maintain Blade Flurry at all times when 2 or more targets are present.
Keep Roll the Bones active; reroll if you only have 1 buff active.
Use Adrenaline Rush on cooldown, ideally when not already at maximum energy.
Use Keep It Rolling when you have 2 or more buffs active to extend their duration.
Spend Combo Points on finishers when at 5 or 6 (Max - 1).
Use Between the Eyes as your highest priority finisher.
Maintain Slice and Dice using a finisher if the buff expires.
Use Coup de Grace as a finisher whenever the Disorienting Strikes buff is active.
Use Killing Spree as a finisher on cooldown.
Use Dispatch as a filler finisher if Between the Eyes is on cooldown.
Use Vanish to trigger Hidden Opportunity if you do not have Audacity or Opportunity buffs active.
Use Blade Rush on cooldown for damage and energy regeneration.
Use Ambush whenever Hidden Opportunity or Audacity procs are active.
Use Pistol Shot with Opportunity procs if you have a large Combo Point deficit or are about to cap stacks.
Use Sinister Strike as your basic filler to generate Combo Points.
